passage.label: Allah created seven heavens earth like them command descends among them know Allah over all competent encompassed all knowledge

arabicExcerpts.text: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٖ وَمِنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مِثۡلَهُنَّۖ يَتَنَزَّلُ ٱلۡأَمۡرُ بَيۡنَهُنَّ لِتَعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدۡ أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عِلۡمَۢا

mainSubject.label: Allah creating seven heavens and earths alike with His command descending among them so they know He is competent over all things and has encompassed everything in knowledge

subordinateSubjects.label: Seven heavens and earths alike created with His command descending among them so they know He is competent over all things and has encompassed everything in knowledge

relationships.label: Seven heavens and earths alike with command descending among them demonstrating competence and comprehensive knowledge

notes: Wave 9 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the capacity-based spending and ease-after-hardship principle (7) before the historical-warning block opens (8); P2 ends with the garden-admission and perfected-provision promise (11) before the closing cosmological declaration (12); P3 is the single-verse cosmic frame affirming competence and comprehensive knowledge.
